title: Generalized matching decoders for 2D topological translationally-invariant codes
summary: Two-dimensional topological translationally-invariant (TTI) quantum codes, such as the toric code (TC) and bivariate bicycle (BB) codes, are promising candidates for fault-tolerant quantum computation. For such codes to be practically relevant, their decoders must successfully correct the most likely errors while remaining computationally efficient. For the TC, graph-matching decoders satisfy both requirements and, additionally, admit provable performance guarantees.
